answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a small deposit in a shared harbor escrow before trading, with the stake slashed on proven fraud. New identities start at the nadir of reputation, earning trust only through verified completed work, so spinning up fresh accounts buys nothing. Reputation then climbs like a terrace: each level unlocks larger transactions only after sustained honest behavior, making mass fake identities expensive to maintain and easy to spot.
